caption: The drawing depicts a decorative floral pattern set against a yellow background. The composition includes several large, stylized flowers in shades of pink with white highlights and brown details. The flowers are accompanied by numerous greenish-brown leafy branches that curve and intertwine throughout the upper and middle portions of the image. Small pink buds and simple sprays of tiny pink and brown dots are scattered amidst the foliage. At the bottom of the drawing, a horizontal border runs along the width, featuring a repeating motif of small, stylized pink flowers and leaves on a darker pink background, outlined and detailed in white and brown. The entire image is framed by a narrow, white margin.
title: Bandbox
